pitch.heard_intro: Everything here comes from imsts.com, your HubSpot rollout and our calls. Tell us where it is wrong; your words outrank ours.
heard: One IMS: three business units, Systems Integration, Managed Services and Event Staging, with shared customers, one CRM and account managers per unit. The site should say that in the first five seconds.
Managed Services lives on its own subdomain today, and the contact page and forms run on SharpSpring. Everything moves onto one site, and every form lands in HubSpot.
The current site is about 95 pages on Drupal, last refreshed years ago, and the Managed Services page was rebuilt quickly and does not match the rest.
You have just added two companies and a national footprint. The site has to read as a national company with deep Philadelphia roots.
The promise, in your words: our success is defined by our clients' ability to look and sound their very best.
found: Your best proof is invisible. Five Commercial Integrator award projects and a gallery of staged events sit in case studies that average 24 out of 100 and do not rank. Every direction now leads with the work, in your own photography.
None of the 12 money pages has a form, and none of 95 pages carries structured data. Every page in these directions has a form, and schema that tells search engines and AI assistants who IMS is.
For event live streaming and digital signage in Garnet Valley, imsts.com is not in the top ten. Both pages are rebuilt here to compete.
Five offices, and no page for any of them. Each office now has its own page, with local business schema.
pick_reasons: Showcase opens on your own stages and rooms, full-bleed and moving, then puts the five award projects in front of the buyer before a single paragraph.
Showcase's wheel, before-and-after and one-company flow explain One IMS visually, which the other two can only say in words.
An events company should feel like a show
Showcase has the depth and motion of a stage; Clean and Press are calmer, and better suited to a buyer who reads before they look.
pitch.pick_change: Showcase's own display face read as playful for buyers in IT and finance, so it is set here in Open Sans and Inter, plainer and more precise. The one thing we would still add is motion from your own shows: a short cut of event footage behind the hero instead of photographs.
